headword: {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}
gloss: local train; train stopping at every station

definitions.gloss: local train; train stopping at every station
definitions.explanation: A train service that stops at every station along its route, as opposed to express or rapid services. Often abbreviated to {各停|かくてい}.

examples.japanese: {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}に{乗|の}った。
{急行|きゅうこう}と{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}、どちらが{先|さき}に{着|つ}きますか。
examples.english: Which arrives first, the express or the local?

examples.japanese: この{時間帯|じかんたい}は{各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}しか{走|はし}っていない。
examples.english: Only local trains are running during this time period.

notes:
A compound of {各駅|かくえき} (each station) + {停車|ていしゃ} (stopping). Often abbreviated to {各停|かくてい} in conversation and on station signage.

TRAIN SERVICE HIERARCHY (slowest to fastest):
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}: local (stops at every station)
- {快速|かいそく}: rapid
- {急行|きゅうこう}: express
- {特急|とっきゅう}: limited express

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}に{乗|の}る: to take the local train
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}で{行|い}く: to go by local train
- {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}に{乗|の}り{換|か}える: to transfer to a local

USAGE:
No extra fare is required for {各駅停車|かくえきていしゃ}, unlike {特急|とっきゅう} which often requires a surcharge ({特急券|とっきゅうけん}).
